feature_scope_disclosure_single: {count} reviewed feed record in {place} is tracked here. That is the size of the cohort for {selectedScope}, not a census of its transit.

feature_use_case_hint: Apply a transparent set of filters, then refine it. Presets are evidence shortcuts, not certifications.
feature_ferry_access_hint: Require both ferry terminals and ferry trips to state wheelchair information. This measures published GTFS fields, not physical accessibility or boarding usability.
feature_ferry_access_label: Terminals and trips stating wheelchair information
feature_ferry_access_evidence: Ferry accessibility fields: {terminals}% of terminals and {trips}% of trips state a value
feature_ferry_bicycle_hint: Require a minimum share of ferry trips that state whether bicycles are allowed or prohibited. This measures published policy, not vessel space or boarding conditions.
feature_ferry_bicycle_label: Ferry trips stating a bicycle policy
feature_ferry_bicycle_evidence: Ferry bicycle policy: {percent}% of trips state allowed or prohibited
